test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The policemen thoroughly __examined__ the room where the theft had happened.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Inspected'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence '***The policemen thoroughly examined__ the room where the theft had happened'***. The underlined part is '***Examined***'.
 
• **Examine **means to look at somebody/something carefully in order to find out something

 (किसी वस्‍तु की खोज में) किसी की सावधानी से छानबीन करना.
 __
 
• **Example**- The detective examined the room for clues.
 
 
 
• **Inspected **means to look at something closely or in great detail

 किसी बात की बारीकी या विस्‍तार से जाँच करना, निरीक्षण करना
 
 
• **Example**- All food shops should be inspected regularly.
 
 

Therefore, The correct answer is '**Option 4'** that is '**Inspected'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Restricted **means controlled or limited (नियंत्रित या सीमित).
 
• **Scrambled **means to climb quickly up or over something using your hands to help you; to move somewhere quickly. (हाथों के सहारे जल्‍दी-जल्‍दी ऊपर की ओर या किसी वस्‍तु के ऊपर चढ़ना; जल्‍दी-जल्‍दी कहीं जाना)
 
• **Groped **means to search for something or find your way using your hands because you cannot see. (दिखाई न पड़ने के कारण हाथों से रास्‍ता खोजना अथवा कुछ ढूँढ़ना; टटोलना)
